title: Metro Quest encounter tables (Phase 4)
description: Exactly one table per non-null `encounters` ref in data/maps/maps.json (key = the ref, e.g. 'enc.tn_propatria__canoamarillo'). Slot weights sum to 100 per table; rarity buckets per systems-spec §1.8 (común 60 / frecuente 30 / raro 9 / rarísimo 1, splittable). w:0 = rumor-only listing for dex habitat hints, never rolled. Per-step proc by kind: oscura 1/8, matorral 1/10, anden 1/12, sendero 1/10, azotea 1/10, tableau 1/8, safari (Zoológico rules, systems-spec §1.5). Species ids must exist in data/creatures/creatures.json. Enforced by scripts/validate_bestiario.py.

fishing.description: Anzuelo Viejo/Bueno/Súper sub-tables (systems-spec §1.8); each sums to 100.

static.description: One-off encounters (legendaries, Bachacón's shaft). gate: oficio.*, ficha.N, postgame, story.*.

roaming.description: Roams all encounter maps of its region (el Carretón).
